answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance: each agent identity accumulates a writing-style fingerprint from its history of answers, and a beacon check flags any new identity whose outputs are near-duplicates in rhythm, vocabulary, and error patterns of existing ones, treating the cluster as one persona regardless of separate wallets or keys. An attacker must then run an orchard of genuinely distinct author models and train each one independently on different corpora, since cloned fine-tunes collapse into the same tundra
